name: luvus
description: Mission control for your AI agents (binary luvus). Installed from the latest GitHub release of RizRiyz/luvus over HTTPS.
install: mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin; t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://luvus.dev/install.sh -o "$t" && LUVUS_INSTALL_DIR={{prefix}}/bin sh "$t"; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
upgrade: mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin; t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://luvus.dev/install.sh -o "$t" && LUVUS_INSTALL_DIR={{prefix}}/bin sh "$t"; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
